spec.body_markdown: ## The Three Types of Variables\n\nIndependent variable: the thing YOU deliberately change. Dependent variable: the thing that changes because of it, and the thing you measure. Control variables: everything else you keep fixed so it can't quietly mess with your results. Mix these up and you can't trust your data.
